Brand Identity
Guidelines

A working brand system for Icon Drugs: an established pharmaceutical company with more than 25 years of history, presented with the discipline of a modern corporate identity.

Primary messageHealthcare, built on experience.
DescriptorPharmaceutical Healthcare Solutions
StatusWorking draft, colours sampled from raster
Symbol, reversed on Icon Blue

Brand character

The identity should read as established rather than trendy. The 25 year history is the asset.

An established pharmaceutical company with a modern outlook, trusted for quality, experience and scientific credibility.
It should feelTrustworthy, scientific, reliable, progressive
It should not feelCheap medicine, local pharmacy, generic healthcare startup
Experience

More than two decades in the industry.

Quality

A commitment to consistent pharmaceutical standards.

Reliability

Lasting relationships across the healthcare ecosystem.

Progress

Moving an established business forward.

Brand claims should be validated against Icon Drugs' actual company information before they become final.

Logo and symbol

A stable pharmaceutical foundation supporting life and progress. The concept stays as it is. Only the surroundings are modernised.

Primary logo on white

Reversed on Icon Blue

Orange

Conversion actions, hover states, key numbers. Never a large background.

Purple

The least used colour. Scientific graphics, data visualisation, small accents.

Blue and white

These two dominate. Too much blue reads as a generic pharma template.

Typography

The logo lettering is heavy and dated. The website does not reuse it. Type modernises the brand without touching the logo.

Primary typeface for headings, navigation, buttons, product titles

Manrope
Aa Bb Cc Dd Ee Ff Gg Hh Ii Jj Kk Ll Mm Nn Oo Pp Qq Rr Ss Tt Uu Vv Ww Xx Yy Zz 0123456789

Brand voice. Modern and technical without looking like a technology startup.

Secondary typeface for body copy, technical information, forms, tables

Inter
Aa Bb Cc Dd Ee Ff Gg Hh Ii Jj Kk Ll Mm Nn Oo Pp Qq Rr Ss Tt Uu Vv Ww Xx Yy Zz 0123456789

Information clarity. Reads cleanly in dense product and regulatory content.

Photography

The target is the discipline of Cipla and Dr. Reddy's corporate work, without pretending to be their size.

Manufacturing

Clean, controlled production environments.

Laboratory

Research, formulation and quality control.

Products

Controlled, high quality product photography.

People

Scientists, pharmacists and manufacturing professionals.

Architecture

Modern facility and corporate imagery where available.

Scientific abstracts

Subtle molecular and formulation visuals.

AvoidSmiling doctor looking at camera. Doctor with stethoscope and tablet. Hand holding pills. Generic hospital corridor. Overused blue medical stock imagery.
Clinical, precise and human. Not futuristic.

Graphic language

The visual system is drawn from the logo itself, so the website feels like the same company as the mark.

The arc

Section separators, backgrounds, product category visuals and motion.

25+Years of experience
100%Example indicator
The pillar

Cards, stat indicators, vertical rules and section markers.

The flame

A brand symbol, not a repeated decoration. Use it once, and with intent.

Interface

Pharmaceutical, established and corporate. Not a consumer wellness startup.

Buttons

Explore Products Our Company Business Enquiry

Blue for primary actions. Outlined for secondary. Orange is reserved for important conversion actions, which is what keeps it powerful.

Shape

0 px
4 px
8 px
32 px

4 to 8 px radius, or sharp edges for major sections. No oversized rounded cards.

Iconography

One linear style, 1.5 to 2 px stroke, such as Lucide. No filled, 3D, emoji or multicolour icons.

Do not

Gradients on the logo. Heavy glassmorphism. Rounded SaaS cards everywhere. Anything that looks AI generated. The result should read as a serious pharmaceutical company's identity system.

Voice

Calm and authoritative. The language does the work that adjectives usually try to do.

ConfidentNot arrogant.
ScientificNot overly technical.
ProfessionalNot bureaucratic.
EstablishedNot old fashioned.
HumanNot marketing heavy.
Instead of We are the best pharmaceutical company providing world-class medicines.
We provide high quality medicines at affordable prices.
Write Building trusted pharmaceutical solutions for more than two decades.
Our commitment to quality guides every stage of our pharmaceutical operations.

Healthcare, built on experience.

More than two decades of pharmaceutical experience, driven by quality, reliability and a commitment to better healthcare.

Strategic direction

Preserve the 25 year identity. Clean it technically. Modernise its surroundings. Elevate its presentation.

Do not over-modernise because the website is built in 2026. The logo is an asset because it carries history.

What to avoid

The logo may use five colours. The website should not.

Blue everywhere

It reads as a generic Indian pharma template.

Five colours at equal weight

Keep blue and white dominant, orange as the accent.

Redesigning the flame

It is distinctive. Leave it alone.

Replacing the logo type yet

Reconstruct the vector first, then decide.

Established.Scientific.Trustworthy.Precise.Progressive.
